item.title: ‘Go back to your country’: 8-year-old Texas boy’s tearful video after anti-immigrant bullying goes viral
item.description: A viral video shows an eight-year-old boy, Max, crying after being called an "illegal immigrant" during a football game, despite being born in the US. His mother shared the clip to highlight the profound impact of bullying and anti-immigrant language on children, urging reflection on casual words and their lasting effects.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Meet Jens Kjeldsen: 70-year-old man who protests outside the US Consulate in Greenland every morning in freezing cold
item.description: A 70-year-old retiree, Jens Kjeldsen, stages a daily protest outside the US Consulate in Greenland, holding flags of Denmark, Greenland, and the Faroe Islands. His quiet, routine demonstration signifies resistance against President Trump's renewed interest in acquiring Greenland, emphasizing the territory's sovereignty and the right of its people to decide their future.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Man pronounced dead shocked family after waking up in a body bag while waiting to be embalmed
item.description: A Mississippi family was stunned when Walter Williams, declared dead and sent to a funeral home, was found alive moments before embalming. The rare medical error gave the 78-year-old farmer two unexpected weeks with his family before his final death, turning a traumatic mistake into what relatives later called a brief, unforgettable miracle.
item.dc:creator: TOI Trending Desk

item.title: ‘I left Democratic Party because of their hostility towards God’: DNI Tulsi Gabbard blasts anti-ICE protest inside Minnesota church
item.description: Director of National Intelligence Tulsi Gabbard has condemned an anti-ICE protest that disrupted a worship service at Cities Church in St. Paul, Minnesota. She described the incident as "demoniac" and an attack on religious freedom, linking it to growing hostility towards faith in US politics. The Department of Justice has launched an investigation into the disruption.

item.title: 'Very productive meeting': Trump backs off on Greenland tariff threat; claims to have reached 'framework' for deal with European allies
item.description: US President Donald Trump has called off planned tariffs on European allies, citing a "framework for a future deal" concerning Greenland and the Arctic. Trump announced this on Truth Social, stating the tariffs set for February 1st would not proceed. He also previously ruled out using force to acquire the island from Denmark, demanding immediate negotiations instead.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Aadhaar enters US SSN debate: Far-right political writer Curtis Yarvin sparks backlash with anti-India slur
item.description: Far-right writer Curtis Yarvin sparked outrage by using an anti-India slur while praising India's Aadhaar biometric system over the US Social Security Number. His comments, made during a debate on outdated US identity systems and modern biometrics, drew widespread condemnation for their offensive nature, overshadowing the policy discussion.

item.title: IShowSpeed hits 50 million YouTube subscribers on his 21st birthday during Nigeria stream
item.description: IShowSpeed achieved a monumental 50 million YouTube subscribers on his 21st birthday, January 21, 2026, during a live stream in Nigeria. This historic milestone makes him the first Black individual creator to reach this subscriber count, celebrated amidst a massive fan gathering. He expressed gratitude and set his sights on reaching 100 million subscribers.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: StableRonaldo bans law firm account after viewers flag suspicious clips of FaZe house damage
item.description: Twitch streamer StableRonaldo banned an account identified as a real law firm after it repeatedly clipped footage of damage inside the former FaZe Clan house. Viewers alerted Ronaldo to the suspicious activity, prompting him to question if he was under legal scrutiny or being pranked. The incident adds another layer to the ongoing fallout from FaZe Clan's creator division collapse.

item.title: Kai Cenat-Gigi Alayah Reunion Rumours: Viral lock screen clip debunked; fans question publicity stunt
item.description: A viral clip showing Kai Cenat’s iPhone wallpaper sparked speculation that he had reunited with ex-girlfriend Gigi Alayah. Fans quickly spread theories across social media. However, fact checks revealed the video was from December 2025, before their public breakup. As of January 2026, there is no confirmed reconciliation, and both remain single.

item.title: 'Trump will send you back': Child left in tears after Soccer teammates taunt him
item.description: A viral video captured a young child's distress after his soccer teammates taunted him with xenophobic slurs, including being called an illegal immigrant and threatened with deportation by Donald Trump. The child, born in America, expressed his sadness over the hurtful remarks, sparking outrage online and criticism of the Trump administration's impact.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Ricky Gervais reveals truth behind his death wish of being fed to lions at London Zoo
item.description: Ricky Gervais’s throwaway 2021 joke about being fed to London Zoo lions unexpectedly went viral, drawing a literal response from the zoo and becoming a recurring gag in his Netflix special Mortality. Recently released, the show topped the charts in 51 countries, briefly surpassing Stranger Things, while Gervais reinforced his dark humour with philanthropy, donating £2.43 million to 22 animal charities.
item.dc:creator: TOI Trending Desk
